short_bio: Dr. Gaurav Kumar is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Engineering,  NSS Program Officer at Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, and  a social Enerpreneur working on cyber safety, digital literacy, and youth empowerment.
full_bio:
Dr. Kumar holds an M.Tech and Ph.D. in Computer Science from Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi – his alma mater, where he was also honoured with the University Gold Medal and the Best Volunteer Award by the Ministry of HRD, Government of India for his social and academic contributions.
Dr. Gaurav has previously served at Bennett University (Times Group) and GLA University, Mathura, with significant contributions in teaching, research, NSS coordination, and institutional development. He has delivered more than 58 cyber awareness workshops across educational institutions and communities and developed a self-guided cyber safety training program that has already benefited over 75,000 individuals. He is the editor of the Hindi-language magazine Cyber Sanskar, with 19 published issues based on real-life cybercrime case studies aimed at public education and safety.
He was recently awarded the International Excellence Award for Innovation in Creating Cyber Awareness by the International Skill Development Council (ISDC) and is also certified as a Cyber Crime Intervention Officer by the ISAC Foundation in collaboration with the Ministry of Education, Government of India.
Most recently, Dr. Gaurav has been selected as a Master Trainer and recognized as a Cyber Ambassador under the ISEA Project Phase III, an initiative of MeitY, Government of India. As part of this national mission, he is conducting cybersecurity awareness workshops for college faculty, school teachers, government officials, and community members across Delhi-NCR, further amplifying his efforts toward building a digitally secure society.
With a vision to empower over one million people with digital awareness in the next two years, Dr. Gaurav Kumar continues to be a dedicated educator and cybersecurity advocate, working tirelessly to create a safer digital India.
